title: A slow inspector hits its timeout
goal: How long {{castKey}} waits for the inspector is {{castOwner}}'s call, while {{castApp}} is {{castTask}}.
obstacle: The inspector answers, but later than the key is willing to wait.
control: The gateway gives up at the key's timeout on the lab clock. It is a timeout, not a finding: closed blocks the call, open lets it through, whatever the prompt holds.
